description: This file contains the implementation of a singly linked list class 'LinkedList' with basic operations such as add, remove, size, get, and an internal Node class. It provides core linked list functionality for managing a sequence of String elements.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class representing a singly linked list for String elements, with methods to add, remove, retrieve size, and access elements by index.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, holding a String data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list, returning true if successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, throwing an exception if the index is out of bounds.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Internal method to unlink a node from the list during removal.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object method to find the last node of a given list starting from head.
